context_requirements: Expression of the relevant potassium channel (e.g., KCNMA1, KCNN4, KCNJ8/KCNJ11) in the cell line
A functional readout of channel opening (membrane potential, calcium flux, insulin secretion) that is coupled to transcription
For KATP channels, metabolic stress or a low ATP/ADP ratio to make channel opening consequential
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Coordinate up- or down-regulation of known potassium-channel-responsive genes (e.g., immediate-early genes, insulin/secretory pathway genes) across multiple lines
A shared signature that is reversed by a potassium channel blocker

evidence.supports: Nicorandil decreased macrophage ROS and TNF production, but Northern/slot blot analyses showed the effect was post-transcriptional, implying little direct transcriptional response.
The G-protein-gated potassium channel activator carbamylcholine was used as a functional electrophysiological probe in atrial cardiomyocytes, not as a transcriptional perturbagen.
Diazoxide protected pancreatic beta-cells from lipotoxic apoptosis and reduced ER stress, a cytoprotective rather than a primary transcriptional program.

Diazoxide protected PC12 cells from amyloid-beta-induced ROS and mitochondrial membrane potential changes via mitochondrial KATP channels, again a stress-protective rather than a transcriptional mechanism.
